name: Metabase
description: Open source business intelligence and analytics platform. Create dashboards and explore data without writing SQL.
summary: Metabase is actively releasing patch updates across multiple supported branches. The latest release is v0.65.4 (OSS) / v1.65.4 (Enterprise), released on November 13, 2024. Multiple branches (58.x, 63.x, 64.x, 65.x) are receiving concurrent patch updates, indicating active long-term support across versions. Release notes are available at https://github.com/metabase/metabase/releases, with Docker images and JAR downloads provided for both Open Source and Enterprise editions.

answers.What is the current license?: Open Source edition uses AGPL v3; Enterprise edition uses a commercial license.
answers.Is the project actively maintained?: Yes — multiple patch releases across several branches were published in November 2024.
answers.Is there a cloud-hosted version availabl: Yes — Metabase offers a managed cloud (Metabase Cloud) at metabase.com.
answers.Does it support SSO and SAML authenticat: Yes — SSO and SAML are supported in the Enterprise edition.
answers.What databases/data sources are supporte: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server, BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, SQLite, MongoDB, Oracle, Presto/Trino, Druid, SparkSQL, Athena, and more via drivers.

alternatives.name: Redash
alternatives.review: Open source, query-focused, simpler feature set.

alternatives.name: Apache Superset
alternatives.review: Apache-licensed, rich visualisation library, steeper setup curve.

alternatives.name: Grafana
alternatives.review: Primarily metrics/time-series but increasingly used for general BI.

alternatives.name: Hex
alternatives.review: Close source, enterprise focus, AI Analytics Platform for your whole team

alternatives.name: Tableau
alternatives.review: Offers more sophisticated visualizations and analytics capabilities than Metabase, but is significantly more expensive and not open source.

alternatives.name: Lightdash
alternatives.review: Tightly integrates with dbt for a metrics-first analytics workflow unlike Metabase, but has a smaller feature set and community.
